fields.Name: Collaboration: Data Reach - MJ_BizApps_Collaboration_Examples: Example Chapter Members
fields.Description: Generated by scripts/generate-data-reach-filters.mjs from the types' DataReach declarations (D28): the MJ_BizApps_Collaboration_Examples: Example Chapter Members rows whose path value is the record of an anchor on a space the caller reaches, for example-chapter (Shared, ChapterID -> Anchor:chapter). Do not edit by hand.
fields.FilterText: ([ChapterID] IN (SELECT TRY_CAST(SUBSTRING(x.RecordID, CHARINDEX('|', x.RecordID) + 1, 450) AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER) FROM (SELECT a.RecordID FROM [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[SpaceAnchor] AS a INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[fnCollaborationAccess](TRY_CAST('{{UserID}}' AS UNIQUEIDENTIFIER)) AS f ON f.SpaceID = a.SpaceID INNER JOIN [__mj_BizAppsCollaboration].[Space] AS s ON s.ID = a.SpaceID WHERE a.Role = N'chapter' AND s.SpaceTypeID = 'C716F54B-23F7-4C6D-AD12-F7C95D33F0D0') AS x))
